parsed.claim: Sanity check for the missing 'Moreover' clause: the index clause (∃ H : Subgroup, H.index = 24^n ∧ Nonempty (H ≃* Γ 0)) is consistent at n = 0 for any countable discrete group, using H = ⊤ (index 1 = 24^0). This only checks the n = 0 case of the added conjunct is not contradictory; it does not prove the full strengthened theorem.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_index_clause_n0 :
    ∀ G : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup.{0},
      ∃ H : Subgroup G, H.index = 24 ^ 0 ∧ Nonempty (H ≃* G) := by
  intro G
  exact ⟨⊤, by simp, ⟨Subgroup.topEquiv⟩⟩
